marie-partnerships: Heads-up: Equinox is ready to list their Edge Router. They provided a SOC2 report and an independent penetration test. Need clarity on artifact formats, redaction rules, presign flow, and timeline so we can keep the announcement embargoed until legal signs off. @alan-security @nina-legal @sam-engineering @mohit-si

alan-security: Quick checklist from Sec: signed SOC2 PDF (include scope page + audit date), pen-test executive summary (PDF) with only high/med/low counts, full raw scan exports (Nessus/Trivy/Burp) via presigned S3, and firmware attestation PDF describing signing key provenance. Redact customer PII and obfuscate internal IPs/screenshots. Preferred presign TTL: 7 days (604800s). Include sha256 for each artifact.

sam-engineering: Ingest notes: target path s3://marketplace-evidence/equinox/<artifact>. Filenames: equinox_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>.<ext>. Please include a metadata.txt next to each file with: source, scanner-name, scan-date, sha256. Multipart allowed >100MB. We can generate presigned URLs or you can run: 

aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/equinox/pen-logs/equinox_pen-logs_2025-04-01.tar.gz --expires-in 604800

We have an ingestion lambda that will verify sha256 and tag artifacts into the catalog.

nina-legal: Legal requires an executed NDA or partner-signed data-handling attestation before we accept raw logs. Attestation must list signer name, title, and date. Public announcement language should be high-level: "SOC2 audited" and "pen test performed by [vendor]" only; no vulnerability details. Evidence retention default: 12 months (extendable via contract). I'll share the evidence-handling addendum template.

mohit-si: We'll package: pen-summary.pdf, raw-logs_native.tar.gz, firmware-attestation.pdf, metadata.txt. Two quick Qs: 1) prefer single tarball or separated files? 2) is a partner-signed attestation PDF sufficient or do you require notarization/cert chain for firmware?

alan-security: Prefer separated files for faster triage (summary + native exports + attestation). Partner-signed attestation PDF is acceptable for initial listing. If signing keys are hardware-backed include that fact (HSM/KMS) and any cert fingerprints; we may ask for cert chain later if we rely on runtime verification.

marie-partnerships: Timeline: SI uploads by Tue EOD; security review Wed; legal sign-off Thu AM; embargo lift Thu EOD. @deploy-bot please gate the announcement until legal confirms.

deploy-bot: Hold placed on "equinox-edge-announcement" pipeline until 2025-04-17T23:59:59Z or manual release. Reason: awaiting SOC2/pen-test evidence and legal sign-off. :robot_face:

mohit-si: Acknowledged. We'll upload separated artifacts Tue 09:00 UTC and include sha256 files. Thanks team.

marie-partnerships: I'll send a one-pager to Equinox with presign links, filename policy, NDA link, and the addendum. Ping if anything blocks. :handshake:
